'''Adriana Neumann de Oliveira''' (born 25 January 1980)<ref name=abc/> is a Brazilian mathematician specializing in [[interacting particle system]]s, awarded by the L'Oréal-UNESCO Prizes for women in science in 2016. She is a professor in the Department of Pure and Applied Mathematics of the [[Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://buscatextual.cnpq.br/buscatextual/visualizacv.do?id=K4744479J7|title=Currículo Lattes de Adriana Neumann de Oliveira|date= 3 October 2018|publisher=CNPq (texto informado pelo autor)|last=|first=}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.loreal.com.br/imprensa/not%C3%ADcias/2016/mar/para-mulheres-na-ci%C3%AAncia-premia-jovens-cientistas-brasileiras-em-sua-11%C2%AA-edi%C3%A7%C3%A3o-no-brasil|title=Para Mulheres na Ciência Premia Jovens Cientistas Brasileira em sua 11ª Edição mo Brasil|publisher=L'Oréal Brasil|access-date=2019-01-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190120094029/https://www.loreal.com.br/imprensa/not%C3%ADcias/2016/mar/para-mulheres-na-ci%C3%AAncia-premia-jovens-cientistas-brasileiras-em-sua-11%C2%AA-edi%C3%A7%C3%A3o-no-brasil|archive-date=2019-01-20|url-status=live}}</ref>

Neumann earned her Ph.D. in 2011 at the [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada]]. Her dissertation, ''Hydrodynamical Limit and Large Deviations Principle for the Exclusion Process with Slow Bonds'', was supervised by {{ill|Cláudio Landim|pt|Claudio Landim}}.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=167005}}</ref>

She is an affiliate member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]], elected in 2020.<ref name=abc>{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.org.br/membro/adriana-neumann-de-oliveira/|title=Adriana Neumann de Oliveira|work=Membros|publisher=Brazilian Academy of Sciences|access-date=2022-03-29}}</ref>
